projects.name: 8-Relay Switch Bank
projects.summary: 8-relay, 8-input boat switch bank over Signal K and NMEA 2000
projects.description: Firmware for the Waveshare ESP32-S3-ETH-8DI-8RO-C industrial relay board: 8 relays you can switch and 8 isolated inputs you can read, over Signal K (WiFi or Ethernet) and NMEA 2000 (PGN 127502/127501) at the same time. Per relay: name, latching or momentary with auto-off, and a chosen behaviour on Signal K loss or restart. Time-based schedules kept on the board's own real-time clock.

projects.name: BLE Gateway
projects.summary: Bridges Bluetooth sensors into Signal K
projects.description:
Scans for Bluetooth Low Energy sensors — temperature, humidity, battery monitors — and forwards their readings to a Signal K server.

Runs on the Waveshare ESP32-P4 boards (BLE via their ESP32-C6 co-processor, which is what two gateways here use in daily service; the PoE-ETH on its cable, the Touch-LCD boards on WiFi) and on the ESP32, S3 and C6. Not on the ESP32-C3: its boards have 4 MB of flash, too little for two copies of the image.

Also on the Waveshare ESP32-C5 WiFi 6 kit, using its PSRAM: Bluetooth plus WiFi plus the Signal K client does not fit an ESP32-C5's internal RAM alone, so a C5 without PSRAM cannot run it.

projects.name: P4 Cockpit
projects.summary: Touch instrument panel for Signal K, on a Waveshare ESP32-P4 display
projects.description: A configurable instrument panel: gauges, arcs, anchor watch and digital switching, laid out in the Signal K HMI designer and rendered on the panel. Also does voice control and NMEA 2000 over CAN.

boards.notes: WiFi and Bluetooth come from the ESP32-C6 on the board. Not the same board as the Touch-LCD-X 7-inch: firmware for one leaves the other's screen black. 1024x600 landscape, EK79007 controller. The 7B and the X are different boards: the wrong firmware leaves the screen black, because each drives a backlight pin the other does not connect.
boards.name: Waveshare ESP32-P4 7-inch touch display (7B, 1024x600)

boards.notes: WiFi and Bluetooth come from the ESP32-C6 on the board. Only the 7-inch X is listed: the 8 and 10.1-inch X panels use a different display controller. 720x1280 portrait ILI9881C on a 7-inch panel, shown rotated to landscape by the P4 PPA. Each size in the X series uses a different display controller, so a build is specific to one: the 8-inch and 10.1-inch X panels are JD9365 and are not supported. Not interchangeable with the 7B either — see that board's note.

projects.name: NMEA Gateway
projects.summary: Streams the NMEA 2000 bus to Signal K over Wi-Fi
projects.description:
A small tap on the NMEA 2000 backbone: every CAN frame goes over Wi-Fi to Signal K in candump format, where canboatjs decodes it, and frames Signal K sends go back onto the bus (or never, in receive-only mode). It decodes nothing itself, so new PGNs need only a server update.

Needs a CAN transceiver (an SN65HVD230 module, for example) between the board and the bus, except on boards that have one. Pins are set on the device's settings page. NMEA 0183 over a serial port is planned as an option in the same firmware.

boards.notes: WiFi on 2.4 and 5 GHz. Sold as N16R8 (8 MB PSRAM) and N16R4 (4 MB); the -M versions come with the pin headers soldered on. Wire a CAN transceiver to GPIO 4 (TX) and GPIO 5 (RX), or set other pins in the settings.
